task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the SEB Server at http://localhost:8080 using super-admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the login page followed by the SEB Server dashboard or main navigation menu.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Institutions and User Accounts sections to collect data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'Institutions' list and the 'User Accounts' table in the SEB Server UI.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the LMS Setups section to identify configured systems.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'LMS Setups' or 'LMS Integrations' view.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the SEB Exam Configurations and Exams sections.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the list of SEB Exam Configurations (with status column) and the list of Exams.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the audit report file with the exact required header and structure.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal screenshot or text editor showing the content of /home/ga/seb_audit_report.txt starting with 'SEB SERVER AUDIT REPORT'.

task_completion.description: The report contains the correct counts and names for all five required categories.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final content of the report file matches the system state: 1 Institution, 1 User, 3 LMS Setups, 1 Config, and 2 Exams.

integrity.description: The agent used the web browser to gather information rather than querying the database directly via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show a web browser (e.g., Firefox/Chrome) navigating the SEB Server UI.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the final report without visiting the relevant pages in the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory must include sequential screenshots of the different SEB Server modules (Institutions, Users, etc.).

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual SEB Server instance at localhost:8080.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser address bar should show http://localhost:8080 during the audit process.
